justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ByteArrayClassLoader.java`. The only `CreationAction` usages found by repository search are the two internal bootstrapping calls in the same file (`PackageLookupStrategy.CreationAction.INSTANCE` and `SynchronizationStrategy.CreationAction.INSTANCE`); no other Java file references this nested type.
